title: Agency Baking Support Staff
category: Computer Science, Accounting/Finance, Accounting, Business Economics, Business Administration, Banking
description:
Role Summary
To facilitate customer bill-information inquiries and bill-payment transactions through Azizi Bank’s approved POS devices, ensuring accurate transaction processing, proper customer verification, compliance with the Bank’s procedures, effective customer service, and timely reporting of operational issues.
The position is responsible for assisting customers with bill payments, retrieving and verifying bill information, processing transactions through the approved payment channels, issuing transaction receipts, and escalating failed, declined, or uncertain transactions to the relevant supervisor or support team.

Duties and Responsibilities
POS Device Operations and Bill Payments
Operate the assigned POS device and access the approved application using authorized credentials.
Accurately enter the bill number or scan the bill barcode, as supported by the device.
Verify the displayed bill details with the customer’s bill before proceeding, including the biller, bill reference, and payable amount where displayed.
Proceed with the payment only after confirming the bill information with the customer.
Customer shall Enter the card PIN only when required by the POS workflow and ensure that the customer’s PIN remains confidential.
Review the final transaction response displayed by the POS device.
Provide the printed receipt to the customer for successfully completed transactions and keep one receipt with itself
Additional Key Responsibilities – Cash-In and Cash Handling
· Process Cash-In and bill payment transactions through authorized POS devices in accordance with the Bank’s approved procedures and transaction limits.
· Verify transaction details, accurately count cash received, and confirm successful transactions before issuing receipts.
· Safeguard cash, maintain accurate transaction records, and reconcile physical cash against POS records daily.
· Immediately report cash discrepancies, failed or pending transactions, and suspected fraud to the designated supervisor.
· Ensure timely settlement and handover of cash through authorized procedures.
· Protect customer information and never disclose PINs, share credentials, or process unauthorized transactions.
B. Transaction Monitoring and Exception Handling
Monitor the status of each bill-payment transaction and ensure that the final response is checked before closing the customer interaction.
Distinguish between an explicit transaction failure and a timeout or missing response.
For a transaction returning an explicit APS failure, follow the Bank’s approved reversal procedure and applicable transaction rules.
For a timeout, missing acknowledgement, or uncertain transaction status, mark or report the transaction as suspect in accordance with the approved procedure.
Report cases involving possible customer debit, missing confirmation, duplicate payment, incorrect bill information, or receipt discrepancies to the designated supervisor or support team.
Cooperate with the Operations, ADC, IT, and other authorized teams during investigation and reconciliation.
Maintain transaction references, dates, amounts, POS identifiers, response messages, and other relevant details required for investigation.
C. Customer Service and Assistance
Explain the bill-payment process to customers in a clear and professional manner.
Assist customers in identifying the correct biller, entering bill references, and understanding the information displayed on the POS device.
Confirm the bill details with the customer before submitting the payment.
Provide the customer with the transaction receipt and explain its importance for future inquiries.
Handle customer complaints professionally and refer unresolved matters to the appropriate support channel.
Protect customer information and maintain confidentiality throughout the transaction.
Refrain from requesting, recording, disclosing, or retaining customer PINs or other confidential authentication information.
D. POS Device and Operational Security
Keep the assigned POS device, accessories, and any authorized supporting equipment secure and in good working condition.
Ensure the device is charged, connected, and ready for authorized transactions.
Protect device credentials and prevent unauthorized individuals from accessing the POS application.
Report device malfunction, application errors, connectivity issues, suspected tampering, loss, theft, or unauthorized access immediately.
Use the POS device exclusively for approved Bank services and authorized transactions.
Follow the Bank’s information security, customer confidentiality, and device-handling requirements.
Maintain custody of the assigned device and complete handover or return procedures when required.
F. Compliance and Internal Controls
Comply with the Bank’s approved POS operating procedures, bill-payment instructions, customer service standards, and applicable internal controls.
Follow applicable Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), counter-fraud, and other compliance requirements relevant to the assigned duties.
Never bypass system controls, share credentials, falsify transaction records, or make unauthorized adjustments.
Immediately report suspected misconduct, fraud, security breaches, or violations of Bank procedures.

Job Requirements
Required Qualifications and Experience
Minimum educational qualification: High school certificate; additional education in business, banking, finance, accounting, or having diploma, CIT, DIT and BCS an advantage.
Previous experience in banking, agent banking, POS operations, bill collection, payment services, cash handling, or customer service is preferred.
Basic computer and digital-device operating skills.
Ability to read and accurately enter bill numbers, transaction references, and amounts.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Fluency in the local languages required for the assigned service area; Dari and/or Pashto proficiency is essential according to the location.
Willingness to work in the field and visit assigned agent outlets or service locations, where applicable.
4. Required Knowledge and Competencies
Digital Banking Knowledge: Basic knowledge of digital banking services, including ATMs, debit and prepaid cards, MasterCard services, and mobile wallets, with the ability to guide customers on their use.
POS device operation and basic troubleshooting.
Understanding of successful, declined, failed, and timed-out transactions.
Accuracy, attention to detail, and procedural discipline.
Customer service and complaint handling.
Confidentiality, information security, and fraud awareness.
Basic transaction recordkeeping and reporting.
Communication, teamwork, accountability, and timely escalation.

Submission Guidelines
Kindly Apply through jobs.af ATS ,and all the CV's should be submitted on Thursday before 10:00AM.

description:
Job Summary
PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) Specialist will lead and provide technical support for the planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of DRR activities in Kandahar and Helmand provinces. The position aims to strengthen community resilience to hazards by supporting risk-informed planning, preparedness, mitigation, early warning, and community-based disaster risk management in line with COAR policies and project objectives.
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Primary Responsibilities
• Plan, coordinate, and implement project DRR activities in accordance with approved work plans, budgets, timelines, project objectives, and UNDP standards and require-ments.
• Support community-based disaster risk reduction initiatives, including risk aware-ness, preparedness planning, mitigation measures, and resilience-building activities.
• Conduct field visits and provide technical guidance to project teams and communi-ties to ensure quality implementation and timely resolution of challenges.
• Conduct training sessions for community members in target districts on Early Warn-ing Systems (EWS), including hazard awareness, early warning messages, communi-cation channels, and appropriate actions to take before, during, and after emergen-cies.
2. Technical Support and Expertise
• Provide technical support for the installation, configuration, testing, and operational-ization of Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (MHEWS) equipment and tools in the four target districts, in accordance with UNDP technical standards, specifications, and guidance.
• Coordinate with relevant technical stakeholders to ensure the proper installation, functionality, testing, and handover of MHEWS equipment, and support community members in its safe operation, basic maintenance, and use for timely early warning dissemination.
• Conduct or support hazard, vulnerability, capacity, and disaster-risk assessments in coordination with UNDP and relevant stakeholders; identify at-risk communities and priority needs.
• Support the development and implementation of community disaster risk manage-ment plans, preparedness measures, and locally appropriate risk-reduction actions, in line with project objectives.
• Contribute to early warning and early action activities, including community aware-ness, dissemination of warning information, and coordination of preparedness ac-tions.
3. Coordination and Collaboration
• Coordinate with relevant provincial and district authorities, including disaster man-agement and sectoral departments, as well as community leaders and local structures.
• Ensure effective coordination with the project donor at field, district, and provincial levels, maintain regular communication on implementation progress and operational challenges, and align project activities with agreed implementation arrangements.
• Maintain effective collaboration with COAR program, MEAL, finance, logistics, and other relevant teams to support integrated implementation and ensure compliance with UNDP project requirements.
• Engage NGOs, humanitarian actors, community-based organizations, and other stakeholders to promote information sharing, avoid duplication, and strengthen coor-dinated DRR action.
4. Monitoring and Reporting
• Collect, verify, and maintain accurate field data, activity records, benefi-ciary/community information, and supporting documentation in accordance with COAR procedures and donor reporting requirements.
• Monitor activity progress against approved plans and indicators; identify implemen-tation gaps, risks, lessons learned, and recommendations for improvement, and communicate significant issues to the line manager.
• Prepare timely and accurate field updates, activity reports, assessment findings, suc-cess stories, and other reports required by the line manager and in accordance with UNDP reporting requirements.
5. Adherence to Policies
• Comply with COAR policies, procedures, staff code of conduct, and all applicable project and donor requirements.
• Uphold safeguarding, child protection (where applicable), Prevention of Sexual Ex-ploitation and Abuse (PSEA), protection, inclusion, and do-no-harm principles in all activities.
• Ensure respectful, safe, and inclusive engagement with communities; maintain con-fidentiality and promptly report safeguarding concerns or suspected misconduct through approved channels.
6. Other Duties
• Support capacity-building sessions, community meetings, awareness campaigns, drills, and other activities relevant to the project’s DRR objectives.
• Ensure that project resources, MHEWS equipment, and materials are used responsi-bly, and that relevant installation, operation, maintenance, and handover records are properly maintained in accordance with project requirements and UNDP guidance.
• Perform other reasonable, job-related duties assigned by the line manager in line with the position’s responsibilities and project scope.

Job Requirements
QUALIFICATION AND SKILLS
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Disaster Management, Environmental Science, Civil Engineering, Agriculture, environmental science, Development Studies, water resource management, or another relevant field. Relevant professional training in DRR, climate adaptation, and emergency preparedness is an advantage.
• Experience: At least 4 years of relevant experience in disaster risk reduction, community resilience, emergency preparedness, early warning, humanitarian or community-based programming. Experience working with communities and government authorities in Afghanistan is an advantage.
• Skills: Good knowledge of DRR concepts and community-based approaches; strong coordination, communication, facilitation, and report-writing skills; ability to collect and analyse field information; planning and problem-solving skills; proficiency in MS Office; fluency in Dari and/or Pashto. English-language skills are an advantage.

description:
Role Summary
The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting MOAM’s web, backend, and mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with .NET Core backend development and microservice architecture, Next.js frontend development, Flutter mobile development, and the infrastructure required to run these systems reliably in production.
The position will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of MOAM’s digital logistics ecosystem, including Courier and Cargo products across web and mobile platforms, shared backend services, system integrations, and future digital solutions, with responsibility spanning APIs, distributed services, caching, messaging, observability, databases, containerization, server administration, security, performance, and third-party integrations. The developer is expected to work across the complete software delivery lifecycle and collaborate closely with the Technology Unit and business stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.
· Work with SQL Server and relational data access using Entity Framework Core; design efficient schemas, migrations, indexes, transactions, and queries.
· Implement distributed caching and cache invalidation strategies using Redis or equivalent technologies.
· Use RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, and reliable communication between services; implement real-time application features using appropriate technologies such as SignalR/WebSockets where required.
· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.
B. Frontend Development
· Develop and maintain responsive, secure, production-ready web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.
· Manage mobile application state, API communication, error handling, local persistence, release builds, and application performance.
D. DevOps, Server & Deployment Management
· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.
· Administer and troubleshoot application servers, preferably Linux-based environments, including services, networking, ports, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies such as Nginx, storage, permissions, and resource usage.

· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.
E. Logging, Monitoring & Reliability
· Implement structured application logging using Serilog and centralized log monitoring/analysis using Seq.
· Design meaningful logs, correlation identifiers, health checks, metrics, alerts, and diagnostics to support distributed systems and production troubleshooting.
· Improve application performance, scalability, resilience, fault handling, and availability through profiling, testing, and operational monitoring.
F. Quality, Security & Engineering Practices
· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.

Job Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
· Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
· Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
· Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
· Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
· Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
· Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
